title: WoDX Solo
description: World of Darkness Expanded: The Lone Chronicle, for one person playing alone. A hidden browser holds the Storyteller's seat while the player logs in as a player. One switch sets every automation to act by itself and puts the old values back when it is turned off; a watcher answers or records every card and window that waits for a Storyteller, and the seat follows the player from scene to scene. Switch it on only in a world played alone, never on a shared table. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
